description: 2026/06/11 - 2026/07/19 | Austin stands at a pivotal moment. In a year when the FIFA World Cup transforms North America into the center of global attention our city a capital of creativity innovation and cultural convergence deserves a worldclass celebration that reflects its identity. Austin was not selected as a host city but that reality does not diminish its spirit; instead it fuels our determination to deliver the most ambitious technically flawless and communitydriven unofficial World Cup festival in the United States. The Austin Soccer Fest is our response to this moment: a 39day immersive experience built with engineeringgrade planning internationalevent discipline and the emotional energy that only football can generate.Designed as a temporary urban park adjacent to Rainey Street the festival transforms a simple open lot into a vibrant safe and meticulously organized arena for residents visitors families and football fans. Our approach combines worldclass production standards honed over three decades in Formula 1 Olympic operations global hospitality and multiple FIFA World Cups with the authenticity and creative soul that define Austin. Every element of the project reflects a commitment to operational excellence: controlled crowd flow multilayer safety planning ADAcompliant infrastructure traffic mitigation neighborhood stewardship and a zerocompromise approach to compliance with ACE Fire APD ATD Public Health and TABC.This document presents the Austin Soccer Fest not as an event but as a citybuilding initiative a cultural asset designed to unite Austin around the worlds most popular sport. With responsible planning transparent communication and an unwavering focus on safety and quality we intend to deliver the most elevated inclusive and technically robust football festival the city has ever experienced. Austin deserves nothing less.

description: 2026/06/11 - 2026/07/19 | Austin stands at a pivotal moment. In a year when the FIFA World Cup transforms North America into the center of global attention our city a capital of creativity innovation and cultural convergence deserves a worldclass celebration that reflects its identity. Austin was not selected as a host city but that reality does not diminish its spirit; instead it fuels our determination to deliver the most ambitious technically flawless and communitydriven unofficial World Cup festival in the United States. The Austin Soccer Fest is our response to this moment: a 39day immersive experience built with engineeringgrade planning internationalevent discipline and the emotional energy that only football can generate.Designed as a temporary urban park adjacent to Rainey Street the festival transforms a simple open lot into a vibrant safe and meticulously organized arena for residents visitors families and football fans. Our approach combines worldclass production standards honed over three decades in Formula 1 Olympic operations global hospitality and multiple FIFA World Cups with the authenticity and creative soul that define Austin. Every element of the project reflects a commitment to operational excellence: controlled crowd flow multilayer safety planning ADAcompliant infrastructure traffic mitigation neighborhood stewardship and a zerocompromise approach to compliance with ACE Fire APD ATD Public Health and TABC.This document presents the Austin Soccer Fest not as an event but as a citybuilding initiative a cultural asset designed to unite Austin around the worlds most popular sport. With responsible planning transparent communication and an unwavering focus on safety and quality we intend to deliver the most elevated inclusive and technically robust football festival the city has ever experienced. Austin deserves nothing less.
